Design.evidence_source: [page/65/Text/1] Participants in Study 3 were randomly assigned to 1 of 20 conditions.

country.evidence_source: [page/65/Text/4] Additional payment may also be given to you and/or other MTurk workers. [page/65/Text/5] In particular, after all MTurk workers who are recruited for this study complete it, groups of three MTurk workers will be randomly formed.

info_cost.evidence_source: [page/65/Text/2] After consenting to participate in the study, subjects are informed of the $0.50 study completion fee and of the opportunity to earn additional payment (as shown in Figure A.34). Participants were then provided with instructions about their decision and asked to answer comprehension questions. Figures A.35–A.36 show the instructions and comprehension questions for each of the new conditions.
